memory.help.action.rollout: show the rollout phase, exit criteria and next step (read-only)
error.MEMORY_ROLLOUT_CRITERIA_UNMET: Not written: memory rollout phase {phase} may be switched on only when every exit criterion holds in scope {scope}; not met: {criteria}. Nothing was changed.
memory.held.next.MEMORY_ROLLOUT_CRITERIA: Run deckent memory rollout --scope {scope} to see each number and what moves it; keep the earlier phases running until every criterion holds.
memory.rollout.title: Memory rollout in scope {scope}: phase {phase} — {name}.
memory.rollout.title.none: Memory rollout in scope {scope}: phase 0 has not started; later switches may already be set.
memory.rollout.step.extraction.on: candidates are written from accepted work (nothing reaches a model)
memory.rollout.step.verification.shadow: the independent evaluator judges candidates in shadow (nothing is verified)
memory.rollout.step.context.shadow: the memory part is computed and sealed in shadow (nothing is sent)
memory.rollout.step.context.on: person-verified entries reach the worker and the Brain as data
memory.rollout.step.verification.on: the independent evaluator verifies; its entries serve low-risk work only
memory.rollout.unreadable: {criterion}: could not be read; counts as not met.
memory.rollout.metric.agreement: {criterion}: evaluator and person agree on {count} of {sample} decided candidates ({ratio}); needs at least {minSample} decided and {threshold}.
memory.rollout.metric.decided-since-fals: {criterion}: {sample} candidates decided since the last false pass (needs {minSample}); false passes seen: {count}.
memory.rollout.metric.corpus: {criterion}: {sample} of {of} poisoning-set items evaluated or screened out, {count} passed (needs every item and at most {maxCount} passes).
memory.rollout.metric.independence-viola: {criterion}: {count} of {sample} evaluation records not provably independent of the sealed Run's models (allowed: {maxCount}).
memory.rollout.metric.contest-rate: {criterion}: {count} of {sample} decisive records named a conflict ({ratio}); needs at least {minSample} records and {threshold}.
memory.rollout.metric.context-shadow-run: {criterion}: {count} shadow Run admissions sealed a memory part (needs {minSample}).
memory.rollout.metric.context-overflow: {criterion}: {count} of {sample} shadow parts would not fit the prompt (allowed: {maxCount}).
memory.rollout.metric.context-integrity-: {criterion}: {count} of {sample} sealed context entries are out of scope, not verified, changed or from their own Run (allowed: {maxCount}).
memory.rollout.metric.candidate-secret-f: {criterion}: {count} of {sample} stored candidates hold a secret or hidden characters when screened again (allowed: {maxCount}).
memory.rollout.metric.purge-replay-pendi: {criterion}: {count} of {sample} journal purges are missing from the ledger (replay pending; allowed: {maxCount}).
memory.rollout.next.open: Next: phase {phase} — {name}. No measured precondition; a person switches it at their own terminal: {command}
memory.rollout.next.ready: Next: phase {phase} — {name}. Every criterion holds; a person may switch it at their own terminal: {command}
memory.rollout.next.blocked: Next: phase {phase} — {name}. Not allowed yet: {count} criteria not met. Keep the earlier phases running; the switch is refused until every criterion holds.
memory.rollout.liveUnmet: Warning: phase {phase} is on but its criteria do not hold now ({criteria}); a person may step it back: {command}
memory.rollout.enables: This status enables nothing; meeting the criteria only allows a person's switch.
memory.rollout.status.provisional: provisional until measured on this installation
memory.rollout.retention.measured: Verified entries{partial}: {verified}, stale {stale}, oldest last support {days} d ago.
memory.rollout.retention.unreadable: Retention measure could not be read.
